info.title: Suara Lapangan REST API
info.description: Existing web-compatible API and private mobile document list. Cookie session; existing ASR and document error envelopes intentionally differ. Native auth changes belong to ticket 04.

get.description: Private list, including for admins. Latest owned version per root before filtering; literal case-insensitive search of number, project and client. Sort createdAt and UUID descending. Pass nextCursor unchanged with the same filters; null means no more items. Rate limit: 30 requests per minute in a separate read bucket.
All owned versions in descending version order. Foreign or unowned document identifiers return 404, including for admins. Rate limit: 30 requests per minute in a separate read bucket.
Existing detail access for owners and admins. Version metadata and successor links are filtered by the same access rule.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Replay same request/result for 24 hours; different request under same key returns 409.

post.description: Existing Gmail API delivery. Rate limit 10 requests per minute. A 200 not_marked response means email was delivered but the current revision was not marked sent. Do not retry automatically.
Multipart audio, maximum 32 MiB, rate limit 30 requests/minute plus server quota.

X-Retry-After.description: Seconds until another attempt is permitted; present for the IP limit.

post.description: Better Auth 1.5.5 email/password registration. Email verification is required; duplicate registration can return generic success without confirming account existence. IP limit: 10 attempts per fixed 60-second window from the first accepted attempt, shared across instances.

X-Retry-After.description: Seconds until another attempt is permitted; present for the IP limit.

post.description: Better Auth existing email/password endpoint; login requires verified email. IP limit: 10 attempts per fixed 60-second window from the first accepted attempt, shared across instances.

get.description: Returns the signed-in owner's credential capability. A linked credential with a password takes precedence over social providers. Unknown means capability cannot be established; do not infer it from the login method.
May redirect to callbackURL when supplied.

post.description: Change password using the existing password; optionally revoke other sessions.
Generic response for known, unknown and Google-only accounts. Reset links expire in 30 minutes. Rate limited by email and IP.

X-Retry-After.description: Seconds until another attempt is permitted; present for the IP limit.

post.description: Consume the reset token and revoke old sessions. Send token in JSON body. HTTP 409 RESET_IN_PROGRESS indicates a competing reset; retry without discarding the token.

409.description: Reset in progress; retry with the same token.

X-Retry-After.description: Seconds until another attempt is permitted; present for the IP limit.

get.description: Better Auth callback redirects to an allowed callback URL. Email uses the fragment-based web form to avoid reset tokens in request URLs.

sessionCookie.name: better-auth.session_token
sessionCookie.description: HTTPS uses __Secure-better-auth.session_token; preserve Better Auth cookie handling.

secureSessionCookie.name: __Secure-better-auth.session_token
secureSessionCookie.description: Better Auth session cookie on HTTPS.

Quotation.title: Surat Penawaran / Quotation (K2)
Quotation.description: The document the server stores and the PDF renders, in either locale. Sent to Muse Spark 1.3 with text.format {type: json_schema, strict: true}: every object closes itself with additionalProperties:false and every property is listed in required. nomor, jumlah, total_nominal and terbilang are computed by the server and must never be taken from model output (spec D3/D4 rule 5). `mata_uang` is recomputed from the locale by the server, so this schema does not tie the two together: a strict `json_schema` request refuses a top-level `anyOf`.

jenis.description: Document type. Field names stay Indonesian for both locales; locale and mata_uang decide what is printed.

locale.description: en -> Quotation / Estimate, USD, amountInWords(). id -> Surat Penawaran, IDR, terbilang().

mata_uang.description: Follows locale: en -> USD, id -> IDR.

nomor.description: Server-made document number: calendar year and a four-digit sequence (0001..9999) that resets each year. Null while the draft has not been approved (ticket 01). Never spoken by the user and never invented by the model.

tanggal.description: ISO date the document is issued.

pekerjaan.description: One row per priced item. Every row must cite the turn it came from.

satuan.description: Canonical unit. Adding one is a contract change, not a fixture edit.

sumber_kutipan.description: Turn id (K3) inside the same session, final=true only.

harga_satuan_minor.description: Authoritative minor units: IDR rupiah or USD cents; null means unpriced.

jumlah_minor.description: Authoritative minor units: IDR rupiah or USD cents; null means unpriced.

total_nominal.description: Server-computed: the sum of every pekerjaan[].jumlah.

terbilang.description: Server-computed: amountInWords() for en, terbilang() for id.

butuh_konfirmasi.description: Guard findings (K3 payload). A non-empty list holds the document at perlu_konfirmasi.

sumber_kutipan.description: The turn being questioned, or null when the field is simply missing and no turn can be quoted.

op.description: Explicit acknowledgement of a pending calculated amount; source conflicts require confirm_source.

draft_revision.description: Revision of the persisted draft, absent if no document was persisted.
